cache_method: warm: full untimed read before EACH engine; cold: fadvise DONTNEED plus mincore verification before EACH engine
cold_limit: cold attempts with resident pages or unsupported calls are published but never claimed as verified cold
work: open + auto probe + visit every packet PTS/DTS/size/position, no decode, no per-packet serialization
libavformat_probe: avformat_open_input + av_read_frame; no avformat_find_stream_info (can decode); defaults, no forced format
memory_metric: GNU time peak RSS on ordinary runs; separate Valgrind Massif exact peak requested heap (not timed)
bootstrap_unit: paired repetition, per file; grouped summaries resample whole paired rounds over fixed eligible file set
